nueva-esperanza-west-chicago-il.assessment: Listed in The Trinity Foundation Church Registry & Clearinghouse — a screened registry vetting congregations against confessional Reformed standards (1689 LBCF, Westminster Confession of Faith 1729, or Three Forms of Unity). The Foundation publishes The Trinity Review and Trinity Lectures from a Clarkian/Scripturalist tradition (Gordon Clark, John Robbins).
nueva-esperanza-west-chicago-il.gender_detail: Per confessional Reformed standards (WCF, 1689 LBCF): complementarian; male-only ordination.

score_notes.christology: This life we talk about isn’t found in religion or rules, it’s found in a relationship with Jesus.
score_notes.soteriology: God loves you so much that He made a way for you to truly live — now and forever.
score_notes.mission: We love our city and we want people to know that we're not against them. We are for love and life, for purpose and hope, forgiveness and acceptance, we are for people, family and community, we are FOR MIAMI.

nuova-vita-bologna.assessment: Listed in the Acts 29 church-planting network. Network values: gospel-centered, reformed theology, missional, complementarian, Spirit-empowered. Mark Driscoll was expelled in 2014; current leadership (Brian Howard et al.) emphasizes accountability + elder plurality.
nuova-vita-bologna.gender_detail: Per Acts 29 distinctives: complementarian; male-only ordained eldership.
